mapper.sql: NOTIFICATION_ID, NOTIFICATION_TITLE, NOTIFICATION_CONTENT, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, NOTIFICATION_LEVEL, NOTIFICATION_STATUS, IS_TOP, IS_POPUP, SEND_EMAIL, SEND_SMS, PUBLISH_SCOPE, TARGET_USERS, TARGET_ROLES, TARGET_DEPARTMENTS, PUBLISH_TIME, EXPIRE_TIME, READ_COUNT, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_TYPE = #{notificationType} AND NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, PUBLISH_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_LEVEL = #{notificationLevel} AND NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, PUBLISH_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = #{notificationStatus} ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, PUBLISH_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE IS_TOP = 1 AND NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) ORDER BY PUBLISH_TIME DESC

SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) AND ( PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR (PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'USERS' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, TARGET_USERS)) ) ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, PUBLISH_TIME DESC

SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) AND ( PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR (PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ROLES' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{roleId}, TARGET_ROLES)) ) ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, PUBLISH_TIME DESC

SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) AND ( PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR (PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{departmentId}, TARGET_DEPARTMENTS)) ) ORDER BY IS_TOP DESC, PUBLISH_TIME DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE SYS_NOTIFICATION SET NOTIFICATION_STATUS = #{notificationStatus},
CREATE_BY = #{publishBy},
PUBLISH_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE ,
UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}

UPDATE SYS_NOTIFICATION SET IS_TOP = #{isTop}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}

UPDATE SYS_NOTIFICATION SET READ_COUNT = READ_COUNT + 1, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION n WHERE n.NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (n.EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR n.EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) AND ( n.PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR (n.PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'USERS' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, n.TARGET_USERS)) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ r WHERE r.NOTIFICATION_ID = n.NOTIFICATION_ID AND r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.READ_STATUS = 'READ' )

SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION n WHERE n.NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (n.EXPIRE_TIME IS NULL OR n.EXPIRE_TIME > NOW() SYSDATE ) AND ( n.PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'ALL' OR (n.PUBLISH_SCOPE = 'USERS' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, n.TARGET_USERS)) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION_READ r WHERE r.NOTIFICATION_ID = n.NOTIFICATION_ID AND r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.READ_STATUS = 'read' ) ORDER BY n.IS_TOP DESC, n.PUBLISH_TIME DESC
LIMIT 20
AND ROWNUM <= 20
SELECT FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'SCHEDULED' AND PUBLISH_TIME IS NOT NULL AND PUBLISH_TIME <= NOW() SYSDATE
mapper.update:
UPDATE SYS_NOTIFICATION SET NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'EXPIRED', UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXPIRE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRE_TIME <= NOW() SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 END) as publishedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 END) as draftCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 END) as expiredCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_TOP = 1 THEN 1 END) as topCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_LEVEL IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as urgentCount, SUM(READ_COUNT) as totalReadCount, COUNT(DISTINCT NOTIFICATION_TYPE) as typeCount FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION

SELECT NOTIFICATION_TYPE as typeName, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 END) as publishedCount, SUM(READ_COUNT) as totalReadCount FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION GROUP BY NOTIFICATION_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT NOTIFICATION_LEVEL as levelName, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 END) as publishedCount FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION GROUP BY NOTIFICATION_LEVEL ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT NOTIFICATION_STATUS as statusName, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION), 2) as percentage FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION GROUP BY NOTIFICATION_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
DATE(PUBLISH_TIME) as publishDate,
TO_CHAR(PUBLISH_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as publishDate,
COUNT(*) as publishCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOTIFICATION_LEVEL IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as urgentCount, SUM(READ_COUNT) as totalReadCount FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND PUBLISH_TIME IS NOT NULL
AND DATE(PUBLISH_TIME) >= #{startDate}
AND TRUNC(PUBLISH_TIME) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND DATE(PUBLISH_TIME) <= #{endDate}
AND TRUNC(PUBLISH_TIME) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY DATE(PUBLISH_TIME) ORDER BY DATE(PUBLISH_TIME) ASC
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(PUBLISH_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(PUBLISH_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalNotifications, SUM(READ_COUNT) as totalReadCount, AVG(READ_COUNT) as avgReadCount, MAX(READ_COUNT) as maxReadCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN READ_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 END) as readNotifications, COUNT(CASE WHEN READ_COUNT = 0 THEN 1 END) as unreadNotifications FROM SYS_NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
